Friend, Black Americans fought for generations to secure meaningful political representation. **Today, that hard-won progress is being dismantled district by district.** Last month, Tennessee Republicans approved congressional maps that split Memphis — a city that is 63% Black — across three majority-white districts, effectively eliminating the state's only Black-majority congressional district. And just this week, the Supreme Court allowed Alabama to use a congressional map that a lower court found intentionally discriminated against Black voters. The decision means Alabama voters will cast ballots under a map that federal courts determined unlawfully diluted Black voting strength — another reminder that the protections once guaranteed by the Voting Rights Act are becoming increasingly fragile. **This is about more than maps.** It's about whether Black communities can elect leaders who understand their challenges and will fight for investments in schools, healthcare, jobs, and economic opportunity. It's about whether our democracy reflects voters — or politicians who manipulate district lines to protect their own power. Voting Rights Fund is working to expose voter suppression, elevate threats that too often go unnoticed, and mobilize supporters to defend fair representation before more communities lose their political voice. **But we can’t do this work without people like you.** **[Will you make an urgent contribution today to help us defend democracy, protect voting rights, and ensure Black voters across name: Sharice Davids
subject: I’m the first LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
I couldn’t be more proud to serve as one of just a handful of openly LGBTQ+ voices in Congress
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=6&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p) Happy Pride Month, folks!

Congresswoman Sharice Davids here — Voter Protection Project told me I could reach out with a special message for Pride.

I’m proud to be the first openly LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress.

I’m proud that I’ve broken the mold of what a typical background is for a member of Congress.

And I’m proud to work my heart out every single day to fight back against discrimination and injustice.

[If you’re with me in this fight, then I am humbly asking you to chip in a split donation between my campaign in must-win Kansas’ 3rd and the Voter Protection Project — because, truly, there is so much on the line in this year’s election, including the fundamental freedom to live who we are, openly and proudly.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=7&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sharice Davids and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111045?t=8&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p)

I couldn’t be more proud to serve as one of just a handful of openly LGBTQ+ voices in Congress.

**But things aren’t easy right now. Not in Congress. Not anywhere else.**

Today, National Republicans are more emboldened than ever to treat LGBTQ+ kids as political pawns, to fear-monger about our community, and put LGBTQ+ Americans in danger just to score cheap political points.

**But if there’s one thing I know, it’s this:** I’ve seen the persistence and determination of the LGBTQ+ community. And I know we can keep pushing our country forward, despite all the forces trying to drag us backwards.

[Now, I’m asking you to join me in that fight — not for my own sake, but for your neighbors, your loved ones, and millions of LGBTQ+ Americans across the country who deserve leaders willing to stand up for them. Please, will you chip in $25, $5, even $1 — split between our campaign and Voter Protection Project — to help us keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=13&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p)

Thank you so much for your support, and Happy Pride!

\- Sharice

**I need 10,000 signatures urging Congress to overturn** _**Citizens United**_** -- and I need yours to be one of them.**
I'll get into it more below, but first, I have to ask: **[Can I count on your signature?](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ SIGN THE PETITION](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On January 6th, 2021, I stood inside the United States Capitol while a violent mob tried to tear our democracy apart.
I didn't back down then, and I'm not backing down now.
But the threat to our democracy didn't start _or_ end that day.
In 2010, the Supreme Court ruled that corporations have the same free speech rights as people -- _which means they can spend unlimited money to influence elections._
That opened the floodgates to super PACs and dark money groups. And they've been wide open ever since.
Dark money donors are already flooding this race with over $5 MILLION to boost my opponents and drown out the voices of everyday Marylanders.
* They don't have to tell you their names.
* They don't have to answer to anyone.
* They just have to write the check.

I spent my career protecting people. That's still what I'm doing. And right now, I'm asking you to stand with me against the corruption that's rigging our system from the inside.
**[So please, sign my petition urging Congress to Overturn](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** _**[Citizens United](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[and end unlimited dark money in politics before it's too late:](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thanks for speaking out,
Harry Dunn

subject: The silence wasn’t just awkward. It was damning.

body:
| Last night made one thing crystal clear.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9849%2E5257348%2EiAutQH)
Derek, Last night, I stood on the Senate floor and asked my Republican colleagues a simple question: Who among you thinks Trump's slush fund is a good idea? **_Silence._** Not a single Republican senator spoke up in defense of a scheme that would funnel billions of taxpayer dollars to January 6th rioters, cop beaters, and election deniers. They couldn't defend it — because it is indefensible. So I gave them a chance to do the right thing. I offered an amendment to shut it down. **_While 5 Republicans crossed the aisle to vote for my amendment, the vast majority of them refused to vote their conscience._** Ultimately the amendment was unable to reach the 60 vote threshold and didn’t pass. | [DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20260605_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9849%2E5257348%2EiAutQH)
---
That tells you everything you need to know about where the Republican Party stands today. The party as a whole refuses to defend Trump’s excessively corrupt behavior. But when it comes time to actually stopping him, **_they are frozen in place._**
Simply too scared to cross this corrupt president.
And so they become complicit. In the corruption. In the cover-up. In a plan that rewards the very people who beat police officers with flagpoles and tried to overturn a free and fair election.
Derek, last night illustrated something we must all acknowledge: if there is to be any stopping the corruption, Democrats must retake the Senate majority in November. That is the only way to truly stop what is happening.
That's why I'm asking for your support today. Not tomorrow. Now.

**Breaking: Xavier Becerra is the Democratic nominee for California’s Governor race.**

# [The American Dream Didn't Disappear](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=200791318&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwNzkxMzE4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODA3MTMxMjAsImV4cCI6MTc4MzMwNTEyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc1MzQxNzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.vvH3f4wW5B4QWi40P4_N4H1fl2zoqNjZwZSn354pREc)
### It was chipped away, piece by piece, while politicians looked the other way.
Jun 6
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=200791318&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwNzkxMzE4LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc4MDcxMzEyMCwiZXhwIjoxNzgzMzA1MTIwLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItNzUzNDE3NiIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.8UOgFmh3mg94LQy7gQ0iin3R0rXCe6OOKDx9ZyHhxKg&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/mikefortennessee/p/the-american-dream-didnt-disappear?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

We have all heard the phrase and seen the imagery. Picket fence, a loving partner, maybe a dog and a kid or two. It was all symbolic. It meant that where you started didn't determine where you ended up. That hard work, grit, and refusal to quit could carry you further than privilege or pedigree. That this country gave people a genuine shot at building something real.
I lived that dream. My wife and I both came up through dangerous circumstances that could have buried us. Abuse. Addiction. Crime. The kind of hardship that doesn't make it into campaign brochures. We fought our way out because we refused to stay down, and I built a career from nothing in the music industry. Grammy-nominated albums. Sold-out world tours. A life constructed brick by brick with the help of my family, friends, and neighbors who believed in the same dream.
**But here 's the truth that dream never told me:** the system was quietly being redesigned while people like us were busy surviving it. The ladders were being pulled up, and the politicians who were supposed to protect that dream were busy protecting the people who no longer needed it.
That is the story plaguing districts across the country. Politicians like my opponent have accepted hundreds of thousands of dollars to break down opportunity, and make the "American Dream" really just a dream.
**I need your help to change that, and bring back real opportunity to our working class.[Can I count on your support, just $20, to keep us pushing to make that dream a reality again ->](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Please Pitch in HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **My numbers don 't lie:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a431abfe-4097-4cf4-a596-87ddf14bebb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My name is Mike Cortese, and **[I say the American Dream isn't dead.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** But it's being strangled by a political class that stopped believing it applies to everyone, so I am dedicated to being that reminder.
I'm running for Congress because I am living proof that tomorrow can be better... and because someone needs to go to Washington and fight like hell to make it that way.
_The dream belongs to all of us. Are you with me?_

Mai

[INSIDE JW]

TRUMP ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT UPDATE!

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38008&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1IR0UtRFMzd2hWOCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=18da04d32fd49fa11617bac7407a2c11cf721c14ba69c89c64ac1a1a78263bb1]

FBI RECORDS REVEAL CROOKS’ EMAILS WITH DEPUTY

We’ve uncovered a few more pieces of the puzzle of the attempted
assassination of Donald Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, but they raise
new questions.

We forced the release of 48 heavily redacted pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38004&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTUtMDIyMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=3606afab63ca884706873652441947de8d6ec00e54182b5495e17e342e21b3a2]
from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through a Freedom of
Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit revealing that a Butler County
Sheriff’s deputy exchanged emails with would-be Trump assassin
Thomas Crooks prior to the July 13, 2024, shooting in Butler, PA.

The records indicate that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer
recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from Crooks’
pocket after he was killed.

The records also show that a medic with the Beaver County Emergency
Services Unit told the FBI that she was on the roof of the American
Glass Research (AGR) building examining Crooks’s body when she was
informed that a police canine had “hit” on the building and she
was told to evacuate the roof where Crooks’s body remained.

We filed the July 2025 lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vXWFmdGVyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=640dc1d424a5f8bc2cd14f1dc02ba9ff65b9fa887c6e41dd57c2920b0857af71 the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 FOIA request for all records
related to Crooks and the assassination attempt on then-presidential
candidate Donald Trump. The request included investigative files,
interview summaries, reports, communications, media, and database
records, as well as any FBI communications—across all
formats—between FBI personnel, sources, contractors, or assets and
Crooks himself (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=35651&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2L11fP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c16d098147edc97fe52027deefa95e23eddf421995b70bd09512e2e967ef895f _(No.
1:25-cv-02216)).

A heavily redacted July 17, 2024, FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38005&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTUtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTEwLTEzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=f224cd37a44e253a069b4ab0b8800e2f89d9fc4ce9ff5de9f70fac0cc94c5c47]
titled “Disc of 5 Deputies of the Butler County Sheriff's Office
that were conducted on 07/16/2024” summarizes interviews conducted
with deputies from the Butler County Sheriff’s Office. One deputy
revealed that she had exchanged two emails with Crooks. Further
information about the nature of those emails was redacted:

> On 7/16/2024, TFO [task force officer] [redacted] of the FBI
> TOC-West [transnational organized crime] Task Force and Trooper
> [redacted] of the Pa State Police conducted interviews ...
>

> On Wednesday, July 17, 2024, Special Agent (SA) [redacted]
> telephonically interviewed [redacted] ... After being advised the
> identity of the interviewing agent and the nature of the interview,
> (redacted) provided the following:
>
> [Redacted] advised she [redacted] Thomas Crooks (CROOKS) in the
> [redacted] was an [redacted] therefore [redacted] with CROOKS.
> [Redacted] advised she did not recognize CROOKS when everything was
> on the news over the weekend but on Sunday night, a New York Times
> reporter emailed her asking questions.
>
> [Redacted] advised she checked her emails and records and only had
> two email communications from CROOKS and both emails were in regard

>
> [Redacted] advised she did not have any personal interaction with

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- • | Research Boulevard • | Weiss Ratings Plus | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Jobs Report Blows Past Expectations
U.S. employers added 172,000 jobs in May, [more than double](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAQhp8GO804i7IWFNfY7bVXEoRR2SBsgKzx7S_sPcIlk2lm8v35_p-HemjnXdi-9UGyrFEFOrOnUiipXFIM2zMuOdErpqKdpey2QAoBxxbqKKudvxRvrFyJkG4NyV7cQXDgom92Ke58Aq0t9rbnRMPNrDgZzmEYJqJBNE5WGoww9gBigA6WhTTeJ6H1aEY7MQ5kXYmpe0YXyk6rv-KbUmfi0Xi5l_LK7PbFcGY4n-fZmbCYemQ4VzTDGT5rYDhXm_ZPpz301daHbi-Hb5K0r9N57_IoGIft0M5_Isq_enlL_A0AAP__fOt0zQ) the 80,000 economists expected, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3% for a third straight month. Leisure and hospitality led the gains with 70,000 new positions, followed by local government at 55,000 and healthcare at 35,000. Revisions to March and April added a combined 93,000 more jobs than originally reported, making it [the strongest three-month stretch](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM2KpDAURp8m7lJcb6UTa-GihsFdz2ZgZilXc9X05EeSdItvP1iv0PDtPjhwzt_38Z2cd3H9RYH7uqQx8lE818p5LDWnuH6kqWTeU67kLBe3Rh4RUEu4Nlpy_hxVY_uFGfnecN-aDowCZdpm69u3WS0Krba2062ZDGCHbFQ7daSXx6Nx_UUDDboFMG9wg2liwu5hiPSs7UMoYOtqyreP5GLdePFn-uJ8m1NofL_VuhdxfwocBA7HcdxCidcncOAoP4vAIaTIp8Bh5ciZvMDhspKB8j-uckopFHm4usnWoAQA-brJWrbSRRnolFTkZ-Sw-3QGjlVuydsiS2WyF5myfD5R_cHNiPuQZmfF_eePKywf5Tfnvcm93Q_nvSvaCAVrIOdfCvVb3b96_B8AAP__5haYEQ) in more than two years. Average hourly wages rose 3.4% over the past year. Economists said the stronger-than-expected numbers make it unlikely the Federal Reserve will cut interest rates anytime soon.
## Trump Cancels Freedom 250 Concert Series
President Trump [officially canceled the Freedom 250 concert series](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdBMZB3AoXGxD97bdEg14DPPW2MieBOXvV9lfeNLtrnR0dP58zV_IkdP2Gw9yEvKc6KqRRKjMVUpO23deaqEzF0H2VHlLNBttBtCfzR45vueu8S4QGbo35Fr70LbTnW2b3d1t8A_y7biMg-k6xNGHfuhNv44jtqFr2H1oetBDq7Xt9U0vC6F5jBZxWAc_qk6TZ8nl9p05yU4hvvOLym3NRxPdLnJWdf-lzKTMJDvtHOPnU2ZaYt6qMhMnkJ3gb8qXMlM_tq29W5DyPE7AlPIzrVTheFZeMQKuUiHkAqEQ-XyA6TUUjPENF4HPSeDCJFA5bVQqXCw7pAyCkZIoMzXF-fPiGLkOVnV6O5D_KzXyo8YvZ_4FAAD__1sBkrU) on the National Mall after most of the announced musical acts dropped out, replacing it with what he called "the Greatest Rally, EVER!" on June 24 in Washington, D.C. Instead, Trump said country music star [Lee Greenwood and opera singer Christopher Macchio](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUL2OriAQfRrsNOOI8llQ3IZub3tLM8LoxwbBALvGt79xX2GTyeQUJ-fv38fyQT74uP-lg3Xd0hL5KoFr5byUmlPcP9NaMp8pV_KOi98jLwg4tfDc4siHe5GN0xsz8tCw7tULlASp-uatGcexd1KtagSYHbrByhdKIOncQIoarx81mGDqAdQIHawrE75mRTTZyc1CAjtfU-4-k4_1zVu40zfnzqajCfpd61nE8EegEWiu6-q-CtXk6H4IAk2pKd8CzdNMoDlT8NXbBz7GAg38vFGg2TKzS0eLI7Q2Rcu5tpai5cCuzRTC3QYf-esUaGaQvVJKAiiBpsnanZcPwZdJCQn7QT78JKy_mvVb4_8AAAD__8YLiaM) will perform, alongside performances from the U.S. Army Band, the Armed Forces Choir, the U.S. Marine Band, and the Joint Armed Forces Chorus. Trump added that the rally would feature a speech by "a fine and highly dignified gentleman known as, President DONALD J. TRUMP!" Many performers slated for the original concert series, including Martina McBride, The Commodores, and Bret Michaels, withdrew from the event, with several saying it had become more politically charged than originally presented.
## First AI-Designed Vaccine Tested on Humans
Artificial intelligence has [developed a "fundamentally new" type of vaccine](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAQhp8Gd6zYsRfuCoqNInd3zRUprTEM3llhcICs5bePHOUNTppufv36v-_Xx_SBHDktn7iSbSFPifYaqTUqU20lp-WZ51poy6Uhe6q8JJpAgZbqvMkjx2MaOm8DEVDfkb2aN2UGNZhr97CG-uvNBZxvOhgNfYCgcUBFCJrgFjq2Z5vSSl-VMjd1UfNMCG_vBlE77d_FoMhzy-XyzJzag0I88ovKxeW1i_bR2lZFfxcwChj3fb-sNZ0_ASMl-acKGE8oAWMj90g55uU4k7lELwOX2uQLneNE8j-fl_MhsTQO7Bij5NQoRl4oORIwYpH3Owxf-Plb9GN27EX_88cpkfb6RWXrivXbzjFy1UYMalmR47-57VuOXxb-BgAA__8_O5N6) that was then tested on humans for the first time, according to researchers at the University of Cambridge. The new vaccine used AI to design a "super-antigen" that can train the human immune system against an entire family of viruses, not just one strain. The Phase 1 trial of 39 volunteers found the [needle-free vaccine safe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAMgJ8GtqAQfm_I0IXtunZEJjHgU0hQ4h7i7atUfYNKnqxPn_z56zk_gRz57RMO1LyG2eOVHDJjnBPH4LdXWFLEM0QGspho8zgrqXoh88wWyN1zW1q9IipsStT1MMqhle1Ql7sel1rZzizYDc06GhhXM3bKdqBUZ-zSlKSzTfayr6UcOlnJZUFQ42MA6E1vH0Ur0RKHWL0Ced5xdXd4Y6xMOEqnd-YzFc1HoaZCTdd1VTlhuRkTnGeGCjXlVaGmZAi9wcyF6KxIYqWYWACJvzQr3mAMeRQnpIRJ7N8HeMGRwGUBh3iXUdvzIuco9UPRyu0Acr_X8L9e-NbqJwAA___3iYln) with no significant side effects. A larger Phase 2 trial of roughly 200 participants is planned to measure how well the vaccine actually protects against illness. Researchers say the same approach could eventually target influenza and Ebola virus families.
